name: zoo-ready
js: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 60000) { const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; if (!Z || ['models', 'failed', 'off'].includes(Z.state)) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo; return Z ? { state: Z.state, models: Z.models, failed: Z.failed, triangles: Z.triangles, events: Z.events } : null; })()

name: zoo-check
js: (() => { const Z = window.CITY.highParkZoo, A = window.__CITY_APP, out = {}; A.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isInstancedMesh && /^HighParkZoo/.test(o.name)) out[o.name] = { count: o.count, visible: o.visible, tris: (o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.index.count : o.geometry.attributes.position.count) / 3 }; }); return { zoo: Z ? { mode: Z.mode, state: Z.state, models: Z.models, failed: Z.failed, triangles: Z.triangles, events: Z.events } : null, meshes: out, features: window.CITY.highParkFeatureStats, info: A.renderer.info.render, tier: window.CITY.QUALITY.tier }; })()
